_om: Steinfjeset in English (Stone Face, rusj.no/en/stone-face/) – the try-not-to-laugh game: the clown performs a silly task, the stone face must keep a straight face. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The tasks are in data.en/oppgaver.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Topp fem av {n}. Hele lista kommer på sl: Top five of {n}. The full list comes at the end.
To og to sitter ansikt til ansikt. Klovn: Two players sit face to face. The clown does a silly task from the phone – the stone face must keep a straight face. Don’t laugh!
Klovnen holder mobilen og holder fingere: The clown holds the phone and holds a finger on the card to see the task. The stone face has no idea what’s coming.
Klokka går. Klovnen gjør alt for å få st: The clock is running. The clown does anything to make the stone face laugh – but no tickling and no poking.
Ler steinfjeset, trykker dere «Hen lo!»: If the stone face laughs, tap ‘They laughed!’ and the clown gets a point. If the stone face keeps a straight face until the time is up, the point goes to the stone face.
Et smil teller ikke – det må være et ord: A smile doesn’t count – it has to be a proper giggle or a laugh. You decide how strict to be.
I hver runde er alle klovn én gang og st: In every round everyone is the clown once and the stone face once, with new pairs each round.
Dobbel trøbbel: Begge gjør oppgaven samt: Double trouble: both do the task at the same time and try to make the other laugh. Whoever laughs first gives the other the point. If nobody laughs, both get a point.
Trykket noen feil? «Angre» tar poenget t: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ takes the point back.
Det er alltid lov å bytte oppgave eller: You can always swap the task or skip a turn.
Klovnen tuller – steinfjeset må holde ma: The clown gets silly – the stone face mustn’t crack.
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
One gets silly, one keeps a straight face.
Both get silly – whoever laughs first loses.
To og to møtes. Alle får to dueller per: Players meet in pairs. Everyone gets two duels per round.
Alle blir klovn og steinfjes, med nye pa: Everyone is the clown and the stone face, with new pairs each round.
Sett dere ansikt til ansikt. Begge gjør: Sit face to face. You both do this at the same time:
Klar? Trykk start og sett i gang – {navn: Ready? Tap start and off you go – {navn} must keep a straight face!
{klovn} holds the phone and looks at the card. {stein} looks away.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se oppgave: Hold your finger on the card to see the task
Ingen duell ble ferdig. Prøv igjen – og: No duel was finished. Try again – and remember: don’t laugh!
Ny oppgave – hold fingeren på kortet for: New task – hold your finger on the card to see
Helt greit! Ingen får poeng, og turen gå: No problem! Nobody gets a point, and play moves on.
Den som har flest poeng så langt, vinner: Whoever has the most points so far wins.
